title: Memory Care Ancillary Fee List
content:
Fees under the Memory Care Residency Agreement that are not care add-ons - escorts, guest meals, insurer billing administration, suite changes and returned payments - are listed below for every tier, in US dollars.

| Tier | Staff escort to an outside medical appointment, per hour | Minimum hours billed per escort | Guest meal in the memory care dining room, per meal | Long-term care insurer billed directly, per calendar month | Family-requested move to another suite, per move | Returned payment, per returned payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 45.00 | 1 | 11.50 | 30.00 | 500.00 | 40.00 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 45.00 | 1 | 11.50 | 30.00 | 500.00 | 40.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 45.00 | 1 | 11.50 | 30.00 | 500.00 | 40.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 45.00 | 1 | 11.50 | 30.00 | 500.00 | 40.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 45.00 | 1 | 11.50 | 30.00 | 500.00 | 40.00 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 45.00 | 1 | 11.50 | 30.00 | 500.00 | 40.00 |

## Notes

- Every figure on this list is the same on all six tiers; the suite type and the care program do not change any ancillary fee.
- The escort fee is an hourly rate with a floor of 1 billed hour per escort.
- The insurer administration fee is a monthly figure, 30.00 per calendar month.
- The suite change fee and the returned payment fee are each a fixed amount per occurrence: 500.00 per family-requested move and 40.00 per returned payment.
